# Workflow lines allowed to hide an exit code, read by check_no_advisory.py.
# Format: <path>TAB<the line, stripped>TAB<next non-empty line, stripped>TAB<why the step's verdict does not depend on it>
# The next line pins where an entry applies; one entry allows one occurrence.
# Adding an entry is a CI change: it goes through review, and making a
# blocking check advisory needs the owner's explicit instruction
# (CLAUDE.md, «Ревью и CI»). `check_no_advisory.py --list` prints candidates.
.github/actions/uniffi-android-bridge/action.yml	set +e	yes | "${SDKMANAGER}" --licenses >/dev/null	PIPESTATUS pattern: `yes` dies of SIGPIPE; sdkmanager's own exit code is saved on the next line and tested with `test ... -eq 0` right after `set -e`
